name: Phoenix Finance missing delegateCallSwap authorization
summary: The main implementation exposed delegateCallSwap(bytes) without authorization and forwarded caller-supplied swap calldata to its configured swap module, so the attacker could route assets borrowed into the Phoenix proxy through an attacker-priced token pair.
notes: The proxy runs implementation 0x6d68beb09ea7e76d561ea8c4aac34a6611dd9821, whose unprotected delegateCallSwap forwards to the swap module in slot 14; the module change is the later activation on that route and sets the age.

Gross loss is the exact 10,258.326219 USDC transfer from the Phoenix money pool to the proxy in the exploit receipt. The attacker separately supplied 8,000 USDC to buyLeverage; after Phoenix's 8 USDC fee, 18,250.326219 USDC entered the attacker-priced pair and 18,142.669795 USDC returned to the attack contract. The attacker contract's transaction-level net was 10,132.669795 USDC after its 7,990 USDC flash-loan receipt and 8,000 USDC repayment. The commonly reported $100,000 figure is not used because it is not present in the selected transaction's onchain flows.
